deployWorkerWorkflow.trigger: A merged pull_request closed event to main whose diff includes web/**
actions: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply flow --remote
deployWorkerWorkflow.risk: No migration was pending at the read-only check time, so this merge currently has no D1 migration to apply. The workflow remains structurally coupled to migrations and would apply any unrelated migration that becomes pending before a later deployment; split that behavior in a separate PR.

candidateRuntimeReads.manifestLookup: At most one release_manifest primary-key row per explicit request; exact release_id and STAGED status; no enumeration.
candidateRuntimeReads.artifactLookup: At most one exact declared R2 object per explicit request, capped at 5000000 bytes; no auto-refresh/polling.

security.credential: The browser uses the Cloudflare Access session cookie for same-origin API calls; no INGEST_API_KEY is accepted by the page or sent by the candidate client.
security.accessPolicyEvidence: Cloudflare dashboard showed flow.xiaoker.com app with a flow-only-me Allow policy restricted to the operator account and a separate flow-github-actions Service Auth policy. Candidate Worker verifies Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion RS256 signature, issuer, audience, and temporal claims.
security.cookieHardeningFollowUp: HttpOnly and binding-cookie options were observed disabled and were not changed by this PR; review separately before changing session behavior.

mergeEffects.productionState: No collection, recovery, history backfill, candidate upload/activation, active pointer change, flag change, or production read-path switch is part of this pull request.

rollback: Revert the merged code PR and let the same deploy workflow publish the prior source; this does not require data rollback because the PR writes no production data or schema. Confirm no unrelated pending D1 migration is applied by the deploy workflow before merge.
